title: Depict vs Kimonix: Choosing the Right Merchandising Platform for your Fashion or Lifestyle Brand
summary: In short: Depict is a merchandising, search and recommendations platform for fashion and lifestyle brands. It is built for strong brands’ collection pages and AI-powered product discovery, working across Shopify, Centra, Salesforce Commerce Cloud and headless setups. Kimonix is a Shopify-native, no-code merchandising platform built around profit-weighted collection-sorting, recommendations and an AI shopping agent, now expanding into AI search. Fashion and lifestyle brands that are prioritising visual storytelling and cross-platform flexibility tend to choose Depict; Shopify only brands prioritising automated, margin- and inventory-driven collection sorting tend to choose Kimonix.
